interface.signature: def findSwapValues(A: list[int], B: list[int], N: int, M: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B)
preconditions.description: All elements in A and B are integers.
Length of A is exactly N and length of B is exactly M.
Both N and M are at least 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if any((sum(A) - a + b) == (sum(B) - b + a) for a in A for b in B) else -1
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if there exists a pair (a, b) where a ∈ A, b ∈ B such that swapping a and b makes the sums of A and B equal; otherwise returns -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 == any((a - b) == (sum(B) - sum(A)) for a in A for b in B)
postconditions.description: The condition for swapping is equivalent to (a - b) == (sum(B) - sum(A)), where a ∈ A and b ∈ B.
